feat(herdr): add attention-jump and clipboard-paste bindings

prefix+S-Tab focuses the unfocused agent that most recently became
blocked, else most recently finished, replacing the tmux-jump-bell habit.
prefix+o stays on herdr's in-app toast target, which ui.toast.delivery
skips.

prefix+] pastes the system clipboard as a bracketed paste, since herdr
has no paste buffer. The clipboard command is webframp.herdr.pasteCommand.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

The prefix+A popup now offers an args prompt after the branch prompt,
prefilled from webframp.herdr.agentArgs per agent kind, and passes the
result to the agent on start.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF

feat(herdr): auto-rename tabs after the running command

herdr has no equivalent of tmux automatic-rename, so zsh preexec and
precmd hooks name the tab after the running command, and "zsh" at an
idle prompt. The launcher's tab-name subcommand serializes the
background renames with a per-pane lock and leaves manually named tabs
alone. Disable with webframp.herdr.autoRenameTabs = false.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

content.text:
I split the staged changes into three commits, one per feature:

- `0acec88` **feat(herdr): add attention-jump and clipboard-paste bindings.** This adds `prefix+S-Tab` and `prefix+]`, with their `herdr-launch` subcommands, the `pasteCommand` option and the README rows.
- `eb7becc` **feat(herdr): prefill editable agent args in the worktree popup.** This adds the `agentArgs` option, the args prompt in `cmd_agent`, and the README note.
- `d5880cf` **feat(herdr): auto-rename tabs after the running command.** This adds `herdr-tab-name.zsh`, the `tab-name` subcommand, the `flock` runtime input, the `autoRenameTabs` option and the README line.

Several files held more than one feature, so I built the first two commits from edited copies of the files rather than the working tree. I didn't build or test any of the intermediate commits. The final tree matches what you had staged, byte for byte.

Still uncommitted and untouched: `config/claude/settings.json`, `.swamp/`, `BOOTSTRAP.md` and the WSLg design doc.
